w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Callback is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (21/7/6), with 3 wave-4 fought, 7 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ Leo Martin walks out of the light alone, which is how he walked in — and the galaxy, which came to watch a monster, leaves afraid of the right things. The fear is a shield now, held over a village that trusts the hand that holds it.

ghostLines.line: 🚶 A man, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut is back with Henry.
